The**Ministry of the Interior**([Italian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_language):*Ministero dell'Interno*) is a government agency of[Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy), headquartered in[Rome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rome).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_the_Interior_(Italy)#cite_note-1)It is a[cabinet-level ministry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Italy)of the Italian Republic. Since October 2022, the minister has been[Matteo Piantedosi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matteo_Piantedosi), former Prefect of Rome.

## Responsibilities[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ministry_of_the_Interior_(Italy)&action=edit&section=1)]

The ministry is responsible for internal security and the protection of the constitutional order, for civil protection against disasters and terrorism, for displaced persons and for administrative questions.
